validation.asset_path_test: The checker's asset path was exercised on a throwaway scratch copy (v2 video as a stand-in plus synthetic images). It probed video codec, duration, size and faststart, parsed captions, checked the poster size and warned on a narrow image. The copy was deleted and never entered the repo.
validation.not_performed: No browser rendering or screenshots, per the instruction not to use browser or native UI controls.

responsive_review: Reviewed in CSS, not rendered. Desktop: a 1040 px column for the header, video, steps and footer, with text at 720 px. At 760 px and below: 40 px gutters, single-column roles, smaller headings. At 580 px and below: 32 px gutters, the three top links as an equal three-column grid, 29 px title. The player keeps 16:9 at every width. Prompts and file paths wrap. Screenshots fill the column and open larger on click. Operator review of the draft: no horizontal overflow at 1440 px desktop or 390 px phone, and step 3 reads clearly.
before_publish: Optional final look at phone and desktop widths
